reasoning_details.summary:
**Considering technical updates**

I'm thinking about modernizing the system, possibly with Java 17 and Spring Cloud Data while preserving the XD behavior. I want to avoid unsupported specifics and keep technical decisions clear and concise. It might be helpful to include acceptance testing as a separate topic to ensure everything is exactly right. The JSON schema will support numbers, so let's make sure to formulate our approach effectively while maintaining clarity.

technical_and_design_decisions: Implement the shell using Spring Shell and a REST client against the Spring Cloud Data REST API, limiting command coverage to stream-related operations.
Use existing project conventions and Spring Framework APIs rather than introducing a new command or module architecture.
Implement module metadata discovery using Spring Boot-style @ConfigurationProperties and expose a module-info shell command that lists available module properties.
Port the XD modules as native Spring Cloud Stream source or processor modules while preserving their externally visible configuration and message semantics where practical.
Use the existing project build, dependency-management, testing, and packaging conventions; update dependencies only where required for compatibility.
Provide unit tests for module behavior and command logic, with integration-level tests for REST interaction, metadata discovery, and representative streaming flows.
assumptions: The existing repositories, build files, CI setup, and Spring Cloud Data REST API are available and buildable by the developer.
The required XD module source code and its documentation are available for porting, and no substantial redesign of module behavior is required.
The increment targets Java 17 or newer and the versions of Spring Framework, Spring Shell, Spring Cloud Stream, and related libraries already selected by the target repository.
Authentication, authorization, deployment orchestration, and production infrastructure for the REST API are outside this increment.
The shell only needs stream lifecycle and stream inspection commands needed to demonstrate the stated stream scope; non-stream commands are excluded.
Twitter modules can use existing Twitter client dependencies and configuration patterns; obtaining production credentials and operating Twitter infrastructure are outside the estimate.

Effort includes implementation, developer testing, documentation updates, code review preparation, and local integration verification, but excludes elapsed waiting time and work by other contributors.

activities.activity_description: Review the target repositories, existing Spring Cloud Data REST resources, Spring Shell conventions, XD module implementations, build configuration, and acceptance expectations. Produce an implementation map and identify reusable components.
Set up or update local build configuration, module dependencies, Java compatibility, test fixtures, and packaging conventions required for the shell, metadata support, and ported modules.
Implement stream-focused shell commands, REST client calls, command argument and option parsing, result rendering, error handling, and unit/integration tests for the supported stream operations.

activities.activity_name: Module metadata strategy and module-info command
activities.activity_description: Define the metadata model and discovery strategy using @ConfigurationProperties, bind module properties, implement the module-info shell command, and add tests for metadata listing and invalid or missing configuration.
Port the XD HTTP source module, adapt configuration and message emission to the target streaming APIs, preserve expected behavior, add tests, and verify packaging and pipeline use.
Port the XD TCP source module, adapt networking and message conversion to the target APIs, handle relevant configuration and lifecycle behavior, and add unit and integration coverage.
Move the Twitter stream source module, adapt Twitter client integration and source configuration, preserve event-to-message behavior, and add tests using mocked external interactions.
Move the Twitter search source module, adapt query and polling configuration, preserve result conversion and error handling, and add tests using mocked Twitter service responses.
Port the XD filter processor, adapt expression and message-processing behavior to the target stream module APIs, and add tests for matching, non-matching, and configuration cases.
Port the XD transform processor, adapt transformation and message handling to the target APIs, and add tests for supported transformations, errors, and configuration.

activities.activity_name: End-to-end integration, documentation, and regression verification
activities.activity_description: Verify representative source-to-processor pipelines, shell-to-REST workflows, module metadata output, compatibility with existing tests, and packaging. Update usage documentation, examples, release notes, and address regression issues.
Perform final code cleanup, static analysis review, test-result review, API and configuration consistency checks, commit preparation, and delivery handoff.
